rule-plan.floors: per biome b (floors 5b+1..5b+5): the three floors 5b+2, 5b+3, 5b+4, shuffled by a per-run stream (seed ^ (0x9a221e + 977 b)); the first two get one sigil room each, the third gets a crystal vault (50%) or an elemental treasury (50%)
rule-plan.kinds: all PUZZLE_KINDS except everburn, and library only in biomes 0-1; first kind uniform; second kind uniform among kinds of a different element than the first (rerolled until different)
rule-plan.pocket: carvePocket: a random host room (not start, not boss), random side, size within the given ranges, 2 tiles clear of the map edge, solid rock ring around it, one door tile shared with the host; the host cell inside the door must be floor with no prop and not beside an explosive or poison barrel; up to 260 tries
rule-plan.roomCells: puzzle cells = interior cells (not the centre tile) + edge cells (not the centre, not beside a door or corridor mouth, no prop): the room centre and door-side edge cells are never used
rule-plan.note: every puzzle adds the floor note id puzzle.<kind>; its words are strings.json floor-note.puzzle.<kind> (U9, ui-28)
rule-plan.mastery: holding 3 affinity in the room element solves it on entry for darktraps, sentinels (while not hidden), sentries, chasm (once across), spikes, drowned and baths
rule-plan.solveLog: Name: , class c-kill; sfx puzzle-solved; sight recomputed
rule-plan.src: js/world/puzzles.js:34; js/world/puzzles.js:504; js/world/puzzles.js:107; js/world/world.js:650; js/world/puzzles.js:90; js/world/puzzles.js:297

poisonvault.name: Poison gas vault
layout: 3 puzzle-loot cells farthest from the door
a Firestorm sigil on the free room cell nearest the door
a gas cloud over every floor cell of the room, never expiring

hazards.when: each action, anyone in the cloud (not undead, beetles or objects)
entering the room (once per visit; leaving resets)

offering.name: Offering chamber
layout: an offering bowl (brazier-unlit, kept, green light #73EE75) on the free cell nearest the room centre that is more than 1 from the door and keeps paths open

chasm.name: Chasm vault
layout: a one-tile chasm band across the whole room, one row (or column) in from the door side
3 puzzle-loot cells among the farthest third of the room cells (at least 1)
chasm.air3: stepping toward a chasm with Air 3 grants Levitate 1 and wind-carry, renewed each action while on a chasm

drowned.name: Drowned cellar
layout: every puzzle cell becomes water except the 3 farthest from the door, which keep 3 puzzle-loot items
the room is deep

hazards.when: each move into a water tile of the room, not levitating

effects.note: ordinary damage through the pipeline with resistance (world.md answer 2); 1.7 used direct damage with no defences

hazards.log: The cold water saps you: N damage.

drowned.damageClock: each game turn in the water, moving or waiting (ruled 2026-10-15)

barricade.name: Burning chamber
layout: 3 puzzle-loot cells
every floor cell burns
a water barrel (kept, does not burn) on the free puzzle cell nearest the centre at least 3 (Manhattan) from the door

hazards.when: each action, every floor cell of the unsolved room is set to burn for at least 3 more actions (after the fire tick)
hazards.note: standing in fire: Burn 3 game turns, magnitude sDMG(2), each world pulse (not with Fire 6, not fire creatures); fire spreads out of the room by the ordinary fire rules

barricade.onSolve: fire cleared and every floor cell of the room becomes water for good
barricade.legacy: 1.7 still carries a sealed-barricade path (bump: "The barricade blocks the doorway. Fire would clear it."; Fire 3 or fire burns it: "the timber burns away.") that new floors never use, since every new burning chamber has burning set

hoard.name: Frozen hoard
layout: 3 puzzle-loot items on the 3 farthest cells, each under an ice block (kept, not breakable by blows)
an explosive barrel on the free cell nearest the centre at least 3 (Manhattan) from the door
rules: bumping a block: "The ice is too hard to break. Only fire will melt it." sfx ice-hit, no action spent
Fire 3 bumping a block solves the room: "the ice melts at your touch." (one action)

each action (A14) any block with fire on or beside it (8-way) melts: "Fire melts a block of ice." / "Fire melts N blocks of ice." sfx ice-melt; the last one solves: "the last of the ice runs away as water."
fire ground (a fire field) on the room solves: "the frozen chamber thaws."; fire ground melts the blocks it covers (effects.md G4)
hoard.onSolve: every hoard block on the floor is removed

everburn.name: Everburning door
rules: never planned; a cached plan naming it builds a burning chamber instead
the door tile burns each action
Identify sigil within 3 of the door: "the undying flame gutters out."; Water 3 walking in: "the flame dies at your touch."

baths.name: Scalding baths
layout: puddle ground on every floor cell without ground cover
3 puzzle-loot cells
a poison barrel (kept, does not burn) on the free puzzle cell nearest the centre at least 3 (Manhattan) from the door

hazards.when: each action standing in the unsolved room, not levitating, not cooled
hazards.log: The scalding stone burns you: N damage.

dead: Identify-sigil cooling ("Scalding baths: the stone cools for 10 turns.", 10 actions) never fires: the baths have no sigil
mastery never fires: excluded from mastery

spikes.name: Spike gauntlet
layout: the 3 farthest cells hold puzzle loot
a hidden spike trap on every other floor puzzle cell
spikes.ruling: 2026-09-18: spikes are hidden like any trap; search finds them

sentinels.name: Stone sentinels
layout: 3 puzzle-loot cells, spread (no two adjacent) where possible
a guardian shutoff lever on the free cell farthest from the door
cover pillars at the centre +-1 across the short axis (if paths stay open)
up to 2 sentinel statues on the farthest free cells that keep paths open
rules: entering the room while not hidden: with Stone Skin or Earth 3 it solves ("the sentinels take you for one of their own and sleep on."); otherwise it is marked solved and every sentinel statue becomes a hunting Stone Sentinel
"The stone sentinels wake!" shake 8, sfx golem-alert
sentinels.lever: pulling it solves and disables: sentinels and sentries lose their flag and light, awakened sentinels turn back to dim statues; "The guardians go still." sfx lever; one action
sentinels.solvedBy: the shutoff lever or every sentinel destroyed, with the solve message (ruled 2026-10-15)

darktraps.name: Lightless room
layout: the room is dark
3 puzzle-loot cells (farthest)
5 heavy hidden traps (fire, spark or dart, uniform) on random puzzle cells more than 1 (Manhattan) from the door
a bones prop just inside the door, offset one tile
rules: sight radius in the unsolved room is 1 for everyone (ruled 2026-10-15)
traps here hide 5 times better from passive spotting
darktraps.onSolve: the room is lit and every puzzle trap in it is found

sentries.name: Sentry gallery
layout: 3 puzzle-loot cells spread
lever and cover pillars as for sentinels
up to 2 sentry statues (red light #FF5A4A) on edge cells more than 2 (Manhattan) from the door

hazards.when: each action in the unsolved room, not hidden and Shadow below 3
hazards.each: per sentry statue with a clear projectile path (blocking props stop it)
hazards.log: A sentry's eyes flare: N damage.

library.name: Silent library
layout: dark room
guardian lever at the farthest free cell
2 sleeping keepers on the farthest free cells: duskling in the Dungeon, stalker elsewhere
forbidden library rewards (2 sigils of 2+ motes and a quality-rolled tome) on the farthest free cells
up to 4 bookshelves on edge cells whose row is a multiple of 3 from the top, more than 2 (Manhattan) from the door
rules: first entry wakes the keepers (they remember you): "The library guardians wake."
biome 2+ cached plans build a sentry gallery instead

crystal-vault.name: Crystal vault
layout: pocket 4-6 by 3-4 (else 3-5 by 3-4) behind a crystal door

3 treasures on the farthest free cells, each under a flat violet crystal marker (light #9FE8FF, dim): 1) gear, uncursed, plus at least 0, +1 enhancement; 2) ring or amulet 50/50; 3) one random mote or essence 60-90 + 10 x floor (50/50)
a crystal key on a random free main-room cell
rules: bump without key: "A door of solid crystal. A crystal key on this floor opens it." sfx door-locked
with key: key spent, door opens: "The crystal key rings true. Take one treasure; the rest will shatter." sfx door-unlock (one action)
taking one treasure shatters the others and the markers: "The other treasures shatter." sfx ice-melt

elemental-treasury.name: Elemental treasury
layout: pocket 4-5 by 3-4, sealed door
an elemental lock pedestal on a random main-room cell (80 tries) else just inside the pocket door; no lock means the pocket is filled back in
random element; cost = biome index + 1 motes

5 rewards on the farthest free cells: a weapon for the class (fighter/warrior mace or axe; scoundrel bow or dagger; mage wand or staff; cleric censer or a 2+ mote sigil; tourist any) at tier min(3, 2 + floor(biome/2)), plus 2 + biome, enchanted with the element, uncursed, unidentified; ring or amulet 50/50; three essence piles of 30-50 + 5 x floor
rules: bump the sealed door: "Sealed by elemental magic. A lock pedestal elsewhere on this floor requires N <element> mote(s)."
